Demonstration project

Invoice intake automation for a wholesale distributor

How supplier invoices arriving by email could be read, checked against purchase orders and queued for approval, with a person confirming anything uncertain.

Demonstration projectDistributionAI Automation

This is not client work. It is an illustrative scenario showing how we would approach a problem of this kind. The business described is hypothetical and no results are claimed.

The challenge

A distributor receives supplier invoices as PDF attachments in a shared inbox. An accounts assistant opens each one, keys the details into the accounting system and compares the totals with the purchase order by eye.

The work is slow at month end, mismatches are found late, and nobody can easily see which invoices are waiting or why.

Business requirements

  • 01Capture invoices from the shared inbox without changing how suppliers send them
  • 02Extract supplier, invoice number, dates, line items, tax and totals
  • 03Match each invoice to an open purchase order and flag differences
  • 04Keep a person responsible for approving every payment
  • 05Post approved invoices to the existing accounting system

Solution approach

How we would solve it.

  1. Step 1

    Read

    An intake service watches the inbox, stores each attachment and extracts structured fields using a document model, recording a confidence value for each field.

  2. Step 2

    Check

    Deterministic rules compare the extracted data with purchase orders and supplier records. Arithmetic, tax and duplicate checks run on every invoice.

  3. Step 3

    Review

    Invoices that pass go to an approval queue. Low-confidence fields and mismatches are highlighted beside the original document so the reviewer can correct them quickly.

  4. Step 4

    Post

    Only approved invoices are written to the accounting system through its API, with a link back to the source document and the reviewer's decision.

Technologies used

  • Document extraction model
  • Workflow service
  • Review web application
  • Accounting system API
  • Relational database

Described by type. Specific products are chosen to suit each client’s environment.

Implementation overview

  1. Discovery

    Sample a representative set of invoices, document the current steps and agree the matching rules.

  2. Pilot

    Run the pipeline alongside the manual process for a subset of suppliers and compare the results.

  3. Rollout

    Extend to remaining suppliers, train reviewers and add reporting on exceptions.

Outcomes

What we would measure.

Because this is a demonstration, there are no results to report. In a real engagement we would record a baseline before starting and track:

  • Time from invoice receipt to approval
  • Share of invoices needing manual correction
  • Mismatches caught before payment
